Orphaned since birth, Gu Yuzhu was raised on a mountain by an old Taoist priest, who always told her she was a child blessed with great fortune. Gu Yuzhu never believed him.
That is, until one day—after the old priest passed away—she suddenly found herself transported into an unfamiliar dynasty.
In this new life, she became the beloved darling of her mother, with a handsome twin brother who excelled in his studies and doted on her endlessly. Even her childhood friend from the village, tall and striking, called her his little sweetheart

118181.synopsis:
Xie Wan was a legend.
Born in a general’s manor, she was skilled in both literary and martial arts from a young age. Despite being a woman, she only ever dreamed of one day going to the battlefield to protect her home and country.
But with a single imperial decree, she was summoned into the palace to marry the female Emperor and become an imperial consort.
Four years later, the female Emperor passed away.
When enemy forces invaded, Xie Wan donned armor and went into battle. When treacherous officials plotted rebellion, Xie Wan seized power and executed them.
Everyone thought Xie Wan would become the new Emperor, but until her death, she never sought the throne.
Regarding this, Xie Wan only wanted to say: Being an emperor is truly exhausting.
…
Who would have thought, after being reborn…
She became the female Emperor.
That’s right, she was reborn as the female Emperor—that sickly female Emperor.
Xie Wan: This is terrible, I don’t have many years left to live.
The female official in charge of the name tiles arrived late—
“Your Majesty, today is the day Consort Wan enters the palace. Would you like to go and see?”
Xie Wan’s body stiffened in disbelief, “Who?”
“Your Majesty, it is Consort Wan. The legitimate eldest daughter of General Xie’s family, Xie Wan,” the female official said respectfully.
Xie Wan: ???
Reborn once, she became the female Emperor and married herself.
And it was her sixteen-year-old self, no less.
Sixteen-year-old Xie Wan, for the first time, understood the meaning of resentment.
She loved wielding swords and spears, loved leading troops into battle; even her dreams at night were of herself as a young general.
But with a single imperial decree, she had to put on a wedding dress and become an imperial consort.
She could see the end of her future days at a glance.
The female Emperor loves men, and the harem is filled with them. Not only could she not become a young general, but she also had to compete for favor with this group of men!
Damn that female Emperor!
“Ahem… Consort Wan, you look like you want to eat me,” Xie Wan coughed twice.
“Perhaps it’s because Your Majesty looks delicious,” sixteen-year-old Xie Wan narrowed her eyes. She discovered that the female Emperor seemed even more frail than she had imagined.
“Your Majesty, it’s time to retire,” sixteen-year-old Xie Wan said astonishingly, even pressing closer step by step.
This posture of hers… she doesn’t want to retire to bed, she wants to beat me up!
Xie Wan retreated two steps, “I… just came to see you… I like men, you know…”
Sixteen-year-old Xie Wan, without another word, dragged her away to give her a beating first!
…
Later, the two of them often fought and sparred.
Until… real fights turned into fake fights.
“Your Majesty, didn’t you say… you liked men?” The adult Young General Xie Wan lay limp on the bed.
The female Emperor Xie Wan propped her chin on one hand, wiping the sweat from her forehead, “I don’t know where things went wrong either.”

122789.synopsis:
Yu Wanyin landed a job as a celebrity assistant.
What she didn’t expect was that the person she had a one-night stand with—film queen Qiao Sanghe—would be the very same person she’d have to pretend to date on a reality show centered around intimate couple interactions.
Naive and soft-hearted, Wanyin believed this elegant, aloof beauty was simply cold-tempered and standoffish.
During the show, she tried her best—making Qiao Sanghe heartwarming breakfasts, showing her concern, initiating friendly small talk—but got absolutely nothing in return.
They were even voted “The Couple With the Least Chemistry” by viewers.
Still, Wanyin persisted:
She sweetly asked if Qiao Sanghe was cold, helped her button her coat, fastened her belt, and held her arm when she went downstairs in heels.
She patiently organized her books and notes, made her a heartfelt scrapbook, and even brewed her hand-poured coffee every morning—caring for her in every possible way.
What she didn’t notice… was the way that “cold beauty” had started looking at her with increasing intensity.
Then one day, as Wanyin gently handed her a cup of tea, still thinking Qiao Sanghe wanted nothing to do with her—
Qiao Sanghe suddenly leaned in and kissed her. Hard.
So hard, her lips were left swollen.
Yu Wanyin: “…???”
Only then did the audience realize—
Off-camera, Qiao Sanghe had already kissed Yu Wanyin countless times.
She wasn’t indifferent.
She just only had eyes—and heart palpitations—for one person.
One-line Summary: Fell in love with a film queen
Core Message: Chase your dreams and fight for your future.

140965.synopsis:
I have been reborn six times, and each time I failed to complete the strategy, ultimately being killed by the dark and twisted Male Lead.
After my seventh rebirth, I couldn’t take it anymore. As soon as I opened my eyes, I stormed into the Brothel in a rage and killed the Male Lead with a sword!

Damn it, could he actually be a hardcore masochist?

146341.synopsis:
This is a terrifying, never-ending game initiated by the gods themselves, known as the Playground of the Pantheon.
And somehow, Yi Fengchu, a mere supernatural-phenomena enthusiast, obtained a strange cellphone capable of contacting the Playground of the Pantheon. In return for listening to all manner of eerie ghost stories, he ended up helping one group of players after another escape from certain doom, witnessing the rise of countless legends.
But he never imagined that while he remained addicted to watching the players’ stories as an uninvolved spectator, a rumor began spreading within the Playground, a rumor about Him.
Some extremely fortunate players claimed they once picked up a mysterious phone left behind by an unknown existence within the dungeons. As long as they were willing to trade a terrifying experience of their own, they would receive a chance to survive their moment of utter despair.
They called Him the Narrator, a being detached from all webs of causality, who could speak of life and death as casually as breathing.
He was destiny, and he was eternity.
He was the Ouroboros coiled along the edges of the world, the colossal serpent of the mortal realm, the king of silver-white serpents.
“Without a doubt, this is the Pantheon’s infiltration. And clearly, He has already succeeded, most of the top players have received His blessing and follow His guidance.”
Yi Fengchu: “…I have not.”
“Perhaps He is the ultimate mastermind behind all these nightmares, a witness and observer from a higher dimension.”
Yi Fengchu: “…Who are you talking about?”

149413.synopsis:
I’m bourgeoisie in the realm of unrequited love.
Because my job is to constantly watch over the person I love, protect him, hover around him, and stay alert to everything and everyone nearby.
So I can’t tell Seo Heejin the truth when he worries about my love life.
I still have a mountain of debt, and I can’t afford to get fired. Who would hire a bodyguard with ulterior motives toward his client?
How much would I regret it if I could only see Seo Heejin on a screen or in print?
And yet… I was caught secretly kissing Seo Heejin, who I thought was asleep.
“Did you mistake me for someone else?”
“……”
“Then again, when you miss someone too much, you can start seeing things that aren’t there.”
At his words, a presumptuous, selfish question rose to the back of my throat.
…Who did you miss so much that you started seeing things?
